bind_cpu.description: CPU core ID to pin the process and NIC IRQ to.

bpf_filter.description: BPF filter expression (tcpdump syntax) or path to compiled filter.

drop_group.description: Group to drop privileges to after ring setup.

drop_user.description: User to drop privileges to after ring setup.

fanout_group.description: Fanout group ID for load balancing.

fanout_type.description: Fanout type: hash, lb, cpu, rnd, roll, qm.

input_dev.description: Input network device, pcap file, or stdin (-).

max_packets.description: Max packets to process before exit (0 for infinite).

no_promisc.description: Disable promiscuous mode on input interface.

no_sock_mem.description: Do not modify socket buffer sizes.

notouch_irq.description: Do not touch IRQ CPU affinity.

output_dest.description: Output network device, pcap file, or directory for rotation.

rfraw.description: Enable RFRAW mode for wireless monitor capture.

silent.description: Suppress packet dissector output to terminal.

use_mmap.description: Use mmap I/O for pcap writing.

use_sg.description: Use scatter-gather I/O for pcap writing.
